title: Slice the Pizza
bigIdea: A share is a small slice of ownership in a company.

steps.prompt: You own 1 of 100 slices of a pizza shop. What do you own?
steps.reveal: Right: a share is a slice of the whole company, not a product.

cards.title: Companies sell slices
cards.body: To raise money, a company can sell small pieces of itself called shares.

cards.title: Owners share the upside
cards.body: If the company grows in value, each slice can be worth more.

steps.goal: Raise $400 for a new cart but keep at least 51% of your shop.

steps.prompt: Why did your ownership percentage drop after selling shares?

options.text: You gave away part of the company in exchange for cash

steps.explanation: Selling shares trades ownership for cash.
